title: Farmers at Work, 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo, Imlay City Michigan 1947
description: A black and white snapshot captured on July 6, 1947, showing four men engaged in agricultural work or clearing land in Imlay City, Michigan. In the foreground lies a pile of fieldstones, while men stand and sit around farming equipment and fencing against a backdrop of mature trees. This image reflects post-World War II American rural life and farm labor in Midwestern agricultural communities.
